title: Detection-Driven Object Count Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
reads: Pretrained CLIP-Count density map on the fully generated image and class word, scaled by a pretrained YOLO or DETR count that is excluded from backpropagation; no early noisy steps
trained_on: No counter trained; one text token embedding is optimised for about 30 iterations per class and count against pretrained counters
gradient_enters: Updates the counting token embedding between whole generations through the final denoising step only; it never enters the noise prediction
unseen: partly; token reused across classes at count 10 (MAE 6.11 in-domain, 6.61 out-of-domain), and one sentence reports MAE 8.2 on classes unseen by CLIP-Count against 7.72, with no class list or sample size
headline: Count accuracy with a margin of one above count 2: 45.61% against 26.9% for SD-Turbo on up to 9 objects; at count 2 the plotted YOLO MAE is about 1.0 object against about 1.8 for SD
copy_or_avoid: Avoid gradients through decoded images without a guard against adversarial changes, and score with a counter that did not steer (inferred)
model: SD-Turbo in tables; SDXL-Turbo in the appendix
